channel.title: Majid Babaei: News & Notes
channel.description: Research progress, publications, teaching, and students from Majid Babaei's group.

item.title: An AI agent fixed its tool. Who checks what happens next?
item.description: Let agents propose improvements while trusted code controls what takes effect. Explore SSEVOH-DSL's Harness² integration, run a local demo without an LLM, and inspect the evidence behind each change.

item.title: Research manuscripts under anonymous review
item.description: Identifying details for two manuscripts are withheld while anonymous review is ongoing.

item.title: Closing the loop between humans and agentic AI
item.description: My research agenda in one picture. Two states, Human and AI, and two transitions driven by abstraction. Building that loop efficiently and effectively is what is missing.

item.title: Agent Slicing: finding the blind spots of multi-agent AI teams
item.description: Individual-agent checks miss many defects that only appear when agents are composed. Agent slicing detects them and points to the interactions that explain them.

item.title: Two submissions on checkable agent teams
item.description: Contracts for LLM guardrail hierarchies, and a deterministic controller for untrusted agent proposals. Two ways of carrying human concerns into agentic systems.

item.title: RapidPay accepted to Empirical Software Engineering
item.description: Accepted to Empirical Software Engineering and to appear, RapidPay connects self-admitted technical debt into dependency chains and uses ripple scoring and commit context to prioritize repayment.

item.title: Teaching in Fall 2026
item.description: COMP 370, COMP 481, COMP 155, and CIS 285. My busiest UFV term so far, with 129 students across five sections.

item.title: Completing my term as Chair of Industry Partnerships at UFV
item.description: My term as Chair of Industry Partnerships in UFV's School of Computing ended in September 2026. I continue as a tenure-track Assistant Professor.

item.title: Two papers at ICSE 2026, TAAF and SIKG
item.description: A research paper on trace analysis with knowledge graphs and LLMs, and a poster on semantic impact analysis for adaptive test selection.

item.title: Tech Panel 2026 at UFV
item.description: Organized with the Computing Student Association, Tech Panel 2026 brought practitioners from Zynim, PixelPaddle, Kwixand, and ADAMnetworks to campus.

item.title: Serving the software engineering community in 2026
item.description: This year's organizing and reviewing roles across CASCON, ASE, and FSE.

item.title: Congratulations, Ghazal and Alireza!
item.description: Ghazal Khodabandeh and Alireza Ezaz complete their master's degrees at Brock University and move on to York University and Cohere.

item.title: Joining the University of the Fraser Valley
item.description: After McGill, Concordia, and Queen's, I am joining UFV's School of Computing as a tenure-track Assistant Professor.
